report.summary: All four failures are the same flaky timeout, not four separate bugs. The app's /books rendering (and the redirect after register) calls list_books, which sleeps a random 0-8 seconds at app/main.py:150, while the test fixtures cap every page action at 5 s. Fix first by removing or bounding that random sleep in app/main.py, or by making the tests wait on a deterministic signal instead of a 5 s timeout.

causes.title: /books loads sometimes exceed the 5 s Playwright timeout because list_books sleeps a random 0-8 s
causes.explanation: list_books() in app/main.py calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database. render_books() calls list_books() for every /books page render, and the register POST redirects to /books, so every page that lands on /books is subject to this delay. The UI fixture sets page.set_default_timeout(5000) (tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7). Whenever the random delay is over about 5 s, page.goto('/books') times out (three tests) or the register click's post-submit navigation does not finish in time (one test). Each test only fails on the unlucky draws, so the same commit can pass on a rerun. The other UI tests passed in this run, which fits random rather than deterministic failure. The fixture comment says 'Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s', which the sleep contradicts. The sleep is the underlying cause; the test timeouts are just where it shows up.
evidence: app/main.py:256: "books": list_books(user["id"]),  (called from render_books, used by GET /books)

test_login_ui.py:9 test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... "waiting for scheduled navigations to finish" (click on get_by_test_id("submit") on /register, which redirects to /books)
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the random sleep from list_books in app/main.py, since it has no purpose outside simulating latency. If latency simulation is wanted, make it a fixed, configurable value that is off by default (for example via an env var) and keep it out of the UI test server. Optionally, raise the timeout only for the /books navigation (page.goto(..., timeout=...)) or expect a stable element instead of relying on 'load'. Then rerun the UI suite several times to confirm the failures are gone.
